draft.heroMessage: Meet Dan Scheffel: Your Trusted Guide to Granbury Real Estate
draft.welcomeNote: Hi, y’all, and welcome home! I’m Dan Scheffel—a proud Texan passionate about helping you achieve your real estate goals in Granbury and the surrounding areas.
draft.tagline: Detail-Oriented Service. Local Expertise. Real Results.
draft.aboutParagraph: With lifelong roots in Texas and years of sales experience, I focus on listening to your unique needs, guiding you with expert local knowledge, and always putting customer service first. I chose Granbury for its small-town charm and close-knit community, and I enjoy helping others discover what makes this place special. Whether you’re buying or selling, I’m dedicated to making your move simple and seamless—no detail is too small, and no goal is out of reach. Let’s find your perfect match together.
draft.conciergeLine: Ready to discuss your goals or schedule a viewing? Contact me today, and let’s get you closer to home in Granbury.
draft.contactLine: Call or email Dan Scheffel at Elevate Realty Group: 972-965-6266 | dan@elevaterealtygroup.com
